question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Men and women balanse each other out, and we have to get to a point where we are comfortable with appreciating each other.
Men and women balance each other out, and we have to get to a point where we are comfurtable with appreciating each other.
Men and women balance each other out, and we have to get to a point where we are comfortable with appreaciating each other.
Men and women balance each other out, and we have to get to a point where we are comfortable with appreciating each other.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"balance"** means an even distribution of weight enabling someone or something to remain upright and steady. (संतुलन)

 
 
• **Example: **She lost her balance and fell off the tightrope.
 
 
 
• **"Comfortable"** refers to providing physical ease and relaxation. (आरामदायक)
 
 
• **Example: **The chair is so comfortable that I could sit here for hours.
 
 
 
• Only in **option 4**, all the spellings are correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** "balanse" should be spelled as "balance". (संतुलन)

 
 
• **Example:** We need to balance our work and personal life.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "comfurtable" should be spelled as "comfortable". (आरामदायक)
 
 
• **Example:** The bed is so comfortable that I never want to leave it.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "appreaciating" should be spelled as "appreciating". (सराहना)
 
 
• **Example:** We should spend more time appreciating the little things in life.
